name: aem-edge-delivery
description: AEM Edge Delivery (EDS) demo toolset for Adobe XSC: environment readiness, reusable vertical base templates, creating a demo repo, modernizing a real site with the Experience Modernization Agent (aemcoder), adding integrations like Adobe Target, syncing shared config, and merging features back into a base template. Vertical-aware (manufacturing, retail, …) via a base-template registry.
